fields.description: Issue dated December 1, 1928 (Vol. 5, No. 39). Editorial and local commentary focus on Miami and Miami Beach civic politics and governance, including controversy over one-way vs. two-way downtown traffic changes and criticism of city officials and bond issues. Additional pieces address concerns about Miami’s milk supply and public health oversight, warnings about seasonal criminal schemes targeting tourists, and local institutional matters (e.g., Jackson Memorial Hospital staff policy). The issue includes extensive advertising and notices, including promotions for greyhound racing (Miami Beach Kennel Club/Biscayne Kennel Club), hotel openings, and a paid political advertisement for Miami Beach mayoral candidate Val C. Cleary (election Dec. 18, 1928).
